channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: NBA Game Postponed Due to Fatal Shooting in Minneapolis
item.description: The NBA has postponed the Timberwolves–Warriors game in Minneapolis after a fatal shooting involving federal agents. The decision prioritizes public safety amid unrest in the city.

item.title: Detroit Tigers Predicted to Reunite With Cy Young Legend Justin Verlander
item.description: The Detroit Tigers are predicted to reunite with three-time Cy Young winner Justin Verlander on a one-year deal, forming a fan-favorite 1-2 rotation punch with Tarik Skubal.

item.title: Detroit Lions OC Candidate Lands at Ohio State
item.description: Former Detroit Lions OC candidate Arthur Smith is expected to become Ohio State’s new offensive coordinator after two seasons with the Steelers and three years as Falcons head coach.

item.title: MLB Insider Predicts Outcome for Tarik Skubal Arbitration Case With Detroit Tigers
item.description: ESPN’s Jeff Passan explains why Tarik Skubal could win a record $32 million in arbitration over the Tigers’ $19M offer, citing Cy Young history and elite performance.

item.title: ESPN Drops Bombshell Prediction on Lions Veteran Taylor Decker
item.description: ESPN’s Aaron Schatz predicts the Detroit Lions could cut longtime left tackle Taylor Decker this offseason due to age, injuries, and declining 2025 metrics.

item.title: Latest Tarik Skubal Rumor All But Reveals Detroit Tigers Plan
item.description: MLB insiders reveal the New York Yankees and Mets have virtually no chance of landing Detroit Tigers ace Tarik Skubal after exploratory talks and a massive asking price.

item.title: Former AL MVP Bashes Detroit Tigers Organization for Handling of Tarik Skubal Situation
item.description: Former Yankees star Josh Donaldson blasts the Detroit Tigers as a “trash organization” over their handling of Tarik Skubal’s $32M arbitration case. Here’s what he said and why it matters.

item.title: NBA Insider Says Detroit Pistons Should Go All-In for 9-Time All-Star
item.description: An NBA insider believes the Detroit Pistons should make a blockbuster trade for Kyrie Irving to accelerate their title window and give Cade Cunningham a proven playoff star.

item.title: Tarik Skubal Calls His Shot for 2026 During Cy Young Speech
item.description: Detroit Tigers ace Tarik Skubal hinted at a potential three-peat during his 2025 Cy Young Award speech, telling A.J. Hinch to “keep the same plan” for next year.

item.title: Red Wings G John Gibson is on an ABSOLUTE HEATER Over His Last 19 Games
item.description: John Gibson is 17–2 in his last 19 games with a .931 save percentage, powering the Red Wings to the top of the Eastern Conference after a 5–1 win over the Jets.
